--- /dev/null
+++ b/voluptuous/tests/test_direct_required.py
@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+import pytest
+
+from voluptuous import (
+    All,
+    AllInvalid,
+    Any,
+    AnyInvalid,
+    Coerce,
+    MultipleInvalid,
+    Schema,
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "validator",
+    [
+        Any({"a": int}, {"b": str}, required=True),
+        Any(
+            {"a": Any(float, int)}, {"b": int}, {"c": {"aa": int}}, required=True
+        ),
+        All({"a": int}, required=True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_direct_required_missing(validator):
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as caught:
+        validator({})
+    assert str(caught.value) == "required key not provided @ data['a']"
+    assert caught.value.path == ["a"]
+
+
+def test_direct_required_nested_dictionary():
+    validator = Any({"a": int}, {"c": {"aa": int}}, required=True)
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as caught:
+        validator({"c": {}})
+    assert caught.value.path == ["c", "aa"]
+    assert str(caught.value) == "required key not provided @ data['c']['aa']"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("combinator", [Any, All])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("options", [{}, {"required": False}])
+def test_direct_optional_dictionary(combinator, options):
+    assert combinator({"a": int}, **options)({}) == {}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("required", [False, True])
+def test_direct_success_and_transformations(required):
+    alternative = Any({"a": Coerce(int)}, {"b": str}, required=required)
+    assert alternative({"a": "12"}) == {"a": 12}
+    assert alternative({"b": "text"}) == {"b": "text"}
+    pipeline = All(
+        {"a": Coerce(int)}, lambda value: value["a"] + 1, required=required
+    )
+    assert pipeline({"a": "12"}) == 13
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("combinator,error_type", [(Any, AnyInvalid), (All, AllInvalid)])
+def test_direct_required_custom_message(combinator, error_type):
+    validator = combinator({"a": int}, required=True, msg="supply a")
+    with pytest.raises(error_type) as caught:
+        validator({})
+    assert str(caught.value) == "supply a"
+    assert caught.value.path == []
+
+
+def test_direct_any_leaves_unused_child_uncompiled():
+    validator = Any({"a": int}, object(), required=True)
+    assert validator({"a": 1}) == {"a": 1}
+
+
+def test_direct_all_stops_before_compiling_later_child():
+    validator = All({"a": int}, object(), required=True)
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid) as caught:
+        validator({})
+    assert caught.value.path == ["a"]
+
+
+def test_direct_call_does_not_compile_the_combinator():
+    class DirectAny(Any):
+        def __voluptuous_compile__(self, schema):
+            raise AssertionError("standalone combinator entered enclosing-schema hook")
+
+    validator = DirectAny({"a": int}, required=True)
+    assert validator({"a": 1}) == {"a": 1}
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid):
+        validator({})
+
+
+def test_direct_call_preserves_existing_schema_binding():
+    validator = Any({"a": int}, {"b": str}, required=True)
+    wrapped = Schema(validator)
+    assert validator({"b": "ok"}) == {"b": "ok"}
+    assert wrapped({"a": 1}) == {"a": 1}
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid):
+        validator({})
+    with pytest.raises(MultipleInvalid):
+        wrapped({})

spec.question: Standalone combinators are ignoring their required option: `Any({'a': int}, {'b': str}, required=True)({})` accepts the empty dictionary, although wrapping the same validator in `Schema` rejects it. Make standalone invocation honor this option for Any and All, including nested dictionary children. Missing unmarked dictionary keys must be rejected with `required=True`; the default and explicit `required=False` must remain optional. Preserve successful value transformations, Any's first-success behavior, All's sequential execution, and their existing error types, paths, and custom-message behavior. Keep standalone invocation independent of the combinator's enclosing-Schema `__voluptuous_compile__` hook, retain lazy child-schema construction, and do not disturb an existing Schema binding when the same combinator is called directly. Return a unified diff changing production code only; leave tests unchanged.
